WITH packed_changes AS (
    SELECT d.id AS cr, d.number AS document_number,
           s.spec AS spec, s.release AS release, s.clause AS clause,
           p.pack_number AS pack_number, p.tsg_number AS tsg_number,
           p.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting
    FROM document AS d
    JOIN cr_modifies_section AS ms ON ms.cr = d.id
    JOIN section AS s ON s.id = ms.section_id
                     AND s.spec = d.spec
                     AND s.release = d.target_release
    JOIN cr_in_pack AS pm ON pm.cr = d.id
    JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = pm.pack_id
    WHERE d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.document_number AS document,
                c.spec AS specification, c.clause AS clause
FROM packed_changes AS c
WHERE c.pack_number = 'RP-261256'
  AND c.release IN ('Rel-19')

        SELECT 1
        FROM disposition AS dp
        JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id
        JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id

          AND dp.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
          AND dp.scope = 'whole_target'

        AND previous.release = c.release

FROM seed_clauses AS c
JOIN section AS s ON s.spec = c.spec
                 AND s.release = c.release
                 AND s.clause = c.clause
JOIN cr_modifies_section AS ms ON ms.section_id = s.id
JOIN document AS d ON d.id = ms.cr
                  AND d.id <> c.seed_id
                  AND d.spec = c.spec
                  AND d.target_release = c.release
                  AND d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'
JOIN disposition AS dp ON dp.target = d.id
JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id
JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
JOIN cr_in_pack AS pm ON pm.cr = d.id
JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = pm.pack_id
WHERE dp.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
  AND dp.scope = 'whole_target'
  AND m.wg = 'RAN5';

WITH packed_changes AS (
    SELECT d.id AS cr, d.number AS document_number,
           s.spec AS spec, s.release AS release, s.clause AS clause,
           p.pack_number AS pack_number, p.tsg_number AS tsg_number,
           p.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting
    FROM document AS d
    JOIN cr_modifies_section AS ms ON ms.cr = d.id
    JOIN section AS s ON s.id = ms.section_id
                     AND s.spec = d.spec
                     AND s.release = d.target_release
    JOIN cr_in_pack AS pm ON pm.cr = d.id
    JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = pm.pack_id
    WHERE d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'
),
current_clauses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.spec AS spec, c.release AS release,
                    c.clause AS clause, c.tsg_number AS current_tsg
    FROM packed_changes AS c
    WHERE c.pack_number = 'RP-230920'
      AND c.release IN ('Rel-17')
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM disposition AS dp
        JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id
        JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
        WHERE dp.target = c.cr
          AND dp.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
          AND dp.scope = 'whole_target'
          AND m.wg = 'RAN5'
    )
),
earlier_packs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT previous.spec AS spec, previous.release AS release,
                    previous.clause AS clause, previous.pack_number AS pack_number,
                    previous.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting,
                    previous.tsg_number AS tsg_number
    FROM current_clauses AS c
    JOIN packed_changes AS previous ON previous.spec = c.spec
                                   AND previous.release = c.release
                                   AND previous.clause = c.clause
                                   AND previous.tsg_number < c.current_tsg
),
ranked_packs AS (
    SELECT e.spec, e.release, e.clause, e.pack_number,
           e.tsg_meeting, e.tsg_number,
           MAX(e.tsg_number) OVER (
               PARTITION BY e.spec, e.release, e.clause
           ) AS latest_tsg
    FROM earlier_packs AS e
)
SELECT DISTINCT e.spec AS specification, e.clause AS clause,
                e.pack_number AS cr_pack, e.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting
FROM ranked_packs AS e
WHERE e.tsg_number = e.latest_tsg;

WITH seed_clauses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT seed.id AS seed_id, s.spec AS spec,
                    s.release AS release, s.clause AS clause
    FROM document AS seed
    JOIN cr_modifies_section AS ms ON ms.cr = seed.id
    JOIN section AS s ON s.id = ms.section_id
                     AND s.spec = seed.spec
                     AND s.release = seed.target_release
    WHERE seed.number = 'R5-236825'
      AND seed.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'
      AND seed.target_release = 'Rel-18'
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.clause AS clause, d.number AS document,
                dp.code AS disposition, m.label AS wg_meeting,
                p.pack_number AS cr_pack
FROM seed_clauses AS c
JOIN section AS s ON s.spec = c.spec
                 AND s.release = c.release
                 AND s.clause = c.clause
JOIN cr_modifies_section AS ms ON ms.section_id = s.id
JOIN document AS d ON d.id = ms.cr
                  AND d.id <> c.seed_id
                  AND d.spec = c.spec
                  AND d.target_release = c.release
                  AND d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'
JOIN disposition AS dp ON dp.target = d.id
JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id
JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
JOIN cr_in_pack AS pm ON pm.cr = d.id
JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = pm.pack_id
WHERE dp.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
  AND dp.scope = 'whole_target'
  AND m.wg = 'RAN5';
